messages.content: Selamat pagi. Saya Nurul, Network Intelligence team Shah Alam. Hari ni saya nak setup SLA template baru untuk wholesale carrier customers — name 'Wholesale Gold MY 2026'. Network scope adalah backbone MY + cross-border SG. KPIs minimum: availability 99.95%, latency p95 < 12ms intra-MY, packet loss < 0.01%.
Selamat pagi Puan Nurul. Baik, saya akan cipta SLA template tersebut sekarang.

messages.name: define_sla_template
messages.content: {"sla_id": "sla-whgold-2026", "name": "Wholesale Gold MY 2026", "version_id": "v1.0", "status": "draft", "created_at": "2026-05-21T08:45:01+08:00", "kpi_count": 3, "penalty_count": 2}

Puan, SLA template `sla-whgold-2026` v1.0 telah dicipta dalam status draft, dengan 3 KPI dan 2 tier penalty. Sebelum kita aktifkan, mahu saya senaraikan SLA template lain yang aktif untuk segmen wholesale supaya Puan boleh banding?
Yes please, list yang wholesale_carrier segment je.
Mohon tunggu sebentar.

messages.name: list_slas
messages.content: {"slas": [{"sla_id": "sla-whgold-2026", "name": "Wholesale Gold MY 2026", "status": "draft", "version": "v1.0", "kpi_count": 3}, {"sla_id": "sla-whgold-2025", "name": "Wholesale Gold MY 2025", "status": "active", "version": "v2.3", "kpi_count": 3, "availability_target": 99.9}, {"sla_id": "sla-whsilver-2025", "name": "Wholesale Silver MY 2025", "status": "active", "version": "v1.5", "kpi_count": 2, "availability_target": 99.5}], "total": 3}

Puan, terdapat 3 SLA untuk segmen wholesale:

- `sla-whgold-2026` v1.0 (draft, target 99.95%)
- `sla-whgold-2025` v2.3 (active, target 99.9%) - peningkatan **+0.05%** dalam template baru
- `sla-whsilver-2025` v1.5 (active, target 99.5%)

Boleh saya simulate impact aktivasi `sla-whgold-2026` untuk lihat berapa banyak customer akan terjejas, dan dapatkan dependency graph antara template baru dengan rantai customer-circuit?
Yes both, in parallel. Saya nak ada visibility penuh.
Baik Puan.

messages.name: sla_get_dependency_graph
messages.content: {"root": "sla-whgold-2026", "nodes": [{"id": "sla-whgold-2026", "type": "sla"}, {"id": "cust-wholesale-001", "type": "customer", "name": "Singtel Wholesale"}, {"id": "cust-wholesale-007", "type": "customer", "name": "Telkom MY Wholesale"}, {"id": "probe-prof-cross-my-sg", "type": "probe_profile"}], "edges": [{"src": "sla-whgold-2026", "dst": "cust-wholesale-001", "type": "applies_to"}, {"src": "sla-whgold-2026", "dst": "cust-wholesale-007", "type": "applies_to"}, {"src": "sla-whgold-2026", "dst": "probe-prof-cross-my-sg", "type": "measured_by"}], "depth_reached": 3}

Puan, hasil:

- **Simulation**: 38 wholesale customers / 412 circuits dalam skop. Anggaran breach rate 1.2%, exposure RM 18,420/bulan dalam credit penalty. Amaran: latency probe JB-SG p95 11-13 ms - hampir target 12 ms.
- **Dependency graph**: 2 customer utama (Singtel Wholesale, Telkom MY Wholesale) dan probe profile `probe-prof-cross-my-sg`.

Latency probe JB-SG adalah risiko terbesar. Mahu saya kemas kini template dengan latency target sedikit lebih lega (mis. 14 ms cross-border specific)?
Yes update template — tambah cross-border latency KPI yang lebih realistic, p95 14ms. Bump version. Reason: probe data shows tight tolerance, ingin elak penalty palsu.
Mohon tunggu sebentar.

function.arguments: {"sla_id": "sla-whgold-2026", "base_version_id": "v1.0", "updates": {"add_kpis": [{"kpi_id": "latency_p95_cross_border", "target": 14, "unit": "ms", "scope": "my_sg_cross_border", "measurement_window": "monthly"}], "change_summary": "Add cross-border latency KPI at 14ms p95 to better reflect actual probe envelope. Reduces false penalty risk."}, "new_version_label": "v1.1", "reason": "Probe data shows JB-SG p95 between 11-13ms; adding explicit cross-border KPI prevents false breach."}

Template dikemas kini ke v1.1 (4 KPI sekarang). Sebelum aktivasi, biasanya kita perlu approval lead. Mahu saya buka approval request untuk Encik Lim sebagai Wholesale Lead?
Yes, approval Encik Lim. SLA 6 jam. Tag dengan release q2-wholesale.
Baik Puan.

Approval `appr-sla-22018` dibuka, due 2:50 PM hari ini. Sementara menunggu, mahu saya pull live compliance check untuk SLA terdahulu `sla-whgold-2025` supaya kita ada baseline untuk bandingkan?
Yes pull compliance check untuk sla-whgold-2025. Last 30 days.

Puan, baseline 30 hari `sla-whgold-2025`:

- Overall compliance: **99.92%**
- 2 violations (semua daripada Telkom MY Wholesale cust-wholesale-007)

Mahu saya list violation tersebut secara detail untuk siasatan?
Yes please. List untuk customer cust-wholesale-007 sahaja.

messages.content: {"violations": [{"violation_id": "vio-77011", "customer_id": "cust-wholesale-007", "kpi_id": "availability", "at": "2026-04-29T03:14:00+08:00", "duration_minutes": 47, "severity": "major"}, {"violation_id": "vio-77023", "customer_id": "cust-wholesale-007", "kpi_id": "latency_p95", "at": "2026-05-12T18:21:00+08:00", "duration_minutes": 28, "severity": "minor"}], "total": 2}

Puan, 2 violation Telkom MY Wholesale:

- `vio-77011` (29 Apr, 3:14 AM) - availability breach, 47 min, **major**
- `vio-77023` (12 May, 6:21 PM) - latency breach, 28 min, **minor**

Mahu saya dapatkan detail penuh major violation `vio-77011` untuk root-cause analysis?
Yes detail vio-77011. Pastu kalau bekas root cause masih recurring, trigger remediation.
Saya semak dahulu.

messages.name: get_violation_details
messages.content: {"violation_id": "vio-77011", "customer_id": "cust-wholesale-007", "kpi_id": "availability", "at": "2026-04-29T03:14:00+08:00", "duration_minutes": 47, "root_cause": {"category": "node_failure", "node_id": "core-rtr-jb-04", "description": "BGP session flap on core router JB-04 due to control-plane CPU spike; recurring 3x in 60 days", "recurring": true}, "impact_assessment": {"circuits_affected": 18, "credit_exposure_myr": 8200.00}, "remediation_suggested": "upgrade_control_plane_firmware OR migrate_to_redundant_node"}

Puan, root cause **recurring** - BGP flap di core-rtr-jb-04, 3x dalam 60 hari. Disebabkan control-plane CPU spike. Disarankan upgrade firmware atau migrate ke node redundant. Saya boleh trigger remediation dengan strategi firmware upgrade sekarang.
Yes trigger remediation. Firmware upgrade strategy. Plan window malam 23 Mei 1am-4am MYT supaya impact minima.
Baik Puan.

messages.content: {"remediation_run_id": "rem-77011-001", "strategy": "firmware_upgrade", "status": "scheduled", "scheduled_window": "2026-05-23T01:00:00+08:00 - 2026-05-23T04:00:00+08:00", "node_id": "core-rtr-jb-04", "created_at": "2026-05-21T08:54:11+08:00"}
Remediation run `rem-77011-001` dijadualkan untuk Sabtu 23 Mei 1-4 AM MYT. Encik Lim baru sahaja approve SLA template - mahu saya rekod keputusan dan aktifkan v1.1 sekarang juga?
Yes record decision dan aktifkan. Activation mode phased — start dari 1 Jun. Pastu pin satu dashboard tile untuk monitor compliance live.
Mohon tunggu sebentar.

- SLA template baru `sla-whgold-2026` v1.1 aktif berperingkat (1 Jun pilot, 15 Jun full)
